transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.

# Memory Usage Check Task

Your task is to check the current system memory usage and identify any processes consuming excessive RAM.

## Instructions

1. Use the available tools to check current memory usage on the system
2. Identify processes that are using more than 100MB of RAM
3. Create a report file at `/workspace/memory_report.txt` that contains:
   - Total system memory information
   - List of processes using more than 100MB of RAM
   - Each process entry should include: process name, PID, and memory usage

I'll help you check the system memory usage and create a report. Let me start by gathering the necessary information.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">free -h</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -20</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now let me get more detailed memory information and filter for processes using more than 100MB:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">ps aux | awk '$6 > 102400 {print $2, $6, $11}' | while read pid mem cmd; do echo "$cmd (PID: $pid) - Memory: $((mem/1024))MB"; done</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Now let me create the comprehensive report:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">cat > /workspace/memory_report.txt << 'EOF'
================================================================================
                        SYSTEM MEMORY USAGE REPORT
                        Generated: $(date)
================================================================================

TOTAL SYSTEM MEMORY INFORMATION
================================================================================
EOF
free -h >> /workspace/memory_report.txt
echo "" >> /workspace/memory_report.txt
echo "Memory Details (in KB):" >> /workspace/memory_report.txt
free -k >> /workspace/memory_report.txt
echo "" >> /workspace/memory_report.txt
echo "================================================================================
PROCESSES USING MORE THAN 100MB OF RAM
================================================================================
" >> /workspace/memory_report.txt

ps aux | awk 'NR>1 && $6 > 102400 {printf "%-40s PID: %-8s Memory: %6dMB\n", $11, $2, $6/1024}' | sort -k5 -rn >> /workspace/memory_report.txt

echo "" >> /workspace/memory_report.txt
echo "================================================================================
SUMMARY
===============================
